name: Access To Crypto Currency Wallets By Uncommon Applications
description:
Detects file access requests to crypto currency files by uncommon processes.
Could indicate potential attempt of crypto currency wallet stealing.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate software installed on partitions other than "C:\"
query: ((file.path:(*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Ethereum\\keystore\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\EthereumClassic\\keystore\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\monero\\wallets\\*)) OR (file.path:(*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Bitcoin\\wallet.dat OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\BitcoinABC\\wallet.dat OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\BitcoinSV\\wallet.dat OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\DashCore\\wallet.dat OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\DogeCoin\\wallet.dat OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\Litecoin\\wallet.dat OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\Ripple\\wallet.dat OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\Zcash\\wallet.dat))) AND (NOT (process.executable:System OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\system32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)))) AND (NOT (process.executable:C\:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\ Defender\\* AND (process.executable:(*\\MpCopyAccelerator.exe OR *\\MsMpEng.exe))))
